questions.prompt: In WPILib's command-based framework, which method on CommandScheduler schedules a command to run? Give the method name.
Which command composition class runs multiple commands at the same time and ends as soon as one of them finishes? Give the class name.
Which PIDController method returns true when the measured value is within the configured tolerance of the setpoint?
Which WPILib Timer method returns true once a specified number of seconds has elapsed since the timer was started?
Which method on a SPARK MAX sets whether the motor brakes or coasts when it is not being driven? Give the method name.
Which method makes one SPARK MAX follow another motor controller? Give the method name.
Phoenix 6 status signals are not updated automatically. Which method do you call on a StatusSignal to fetch its latest value before reading it?
Which Phoenix 6 configuration class holds the settings for a TalonFX, and which method applies that configuration to the device? Name both.
WPILib projects declare third-party libraries with vendor dependency files. What file extension do those files use, and which folder in the project holds them?
Which SmartDashboard method publishes a decimal number to NetworkTables under a given key? Give the method name.
This method should return true when value is 5, but it does not compile. Explain the error and write the corrected line.
questions.rubric: = assigns instead of comparing. if (value = 5) is invalid because an int cannot be used as a boolean. Fix: if (value == 5). Bonus: return value == 5;

questions.prompt: For which input does this method return the wrong string, and why? How do you fix it?
questions.rubric: Mode 1 falls through into case 2 because case 1 has no break, so modeName(1) returns "auto". Add break; after name = "teleop";

questions.prompt: Calling average(3, 4) returns 3.0 instead of 3.5. Explain why, and give two different fixes.
questions.rubric: Integer division truncates before the result becomes a double. Accept two of: (a + b) / 2.0, (double)(a + b) / 2, or casting one operand before dividing.

questions.prompt: This compiles, but the robot throws a NullPointerException the first time setSpeed is called. Why, and how do you fix it?
questions.rubric: motor is never assigned, so it is null. Construct it in the constructor, e.g. motor = new CANSparkMax(5, MotorType.kBrushless); with a real CAN ID. Naming null plus constructing the motor is enough.

questions.prompt: What happens when this loop runs, and what is the one-character fix?
questions.rubric: i reaches 10, but valid indices are 0-9, so samples[10] throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. Change <= to <.

questions.prompt: This method does not compile. What is missing, and what should the method body be?
questions.rubric: Missing return statement. Add return speed; (or return 0.5;).

questions.prompt: This sometimes fails even when getMode() returns "teleop". Explain why and write the corrected condition.
questions.rubric: == compares references, not text. Use "teleop".equals(mode) or mode.equals("teleop"). Objects.equals is also acceptable. .equals must be mentioned.

questions.prompt: After calling setSpeed(0.8), the Shooter's speed field is still 0.0. Why? Fix the method.
questions.rubric: The parameter shadows the field, so speed = speed assigns the parameter to itself. Use this.speed = speed;

questions.prompt: What is wrong with this loop, and how do you fix it?
questions.rubric: count is never incremented, so the loop never exits. Add count++; inside the loop body.

questions.prompt: This does not compile. Explain the scoping error and show a corrected version.
questions.rubric: speed is declared inside the if block and is out of scope at motor.set. Declare speed before the if and assign inside it, or move motor.set(speed) inside the block.
